{{Quote|We were outmanned and outgunned, but we achieved our objective, freed all the POWs, and came out alive.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="Bad Intel" />}}
During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Surgeons|squad]] of [[Republic trooper|troopers]] from the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] '''attacked''' an [[Imperial outpost (prison camp)|Imperial outpost]] in order to rescue [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] of war. However, the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] intelligence about the enemy numbers was incorrect, and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] was forced to lead his unit in a fight against a numerically superior opponent. Despite the odds, the squad successfully rescued the prisoners and escaped with no casualties.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The first squad I commanded after making sergeant was sent to free POWs being held at a small Imperial outpost. Intel said the place would be lightly manned. Most of the Imperials wouldn't arrive for another twenty-four hours.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="Bad Intel" />}}
The [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]<ref name="Bad Intel" /> sometime after [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When he achieved the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]<ref name="Bad Intel" /> at some point before the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> Rusk was awarded with command of his [[Surgeons|own unit]].<ref name="Bad Intel" /> The [[Squad/Legends|squad]], which included [[Republic trooper|troopers]] such as [[Karsim]], [[Naja]], and [[Eckerd]],<ref name="Vanished">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Vanished}}</ref> was subsequently given its first assignment. The unit received intelligence on the defenses of the [[Imperial outpost (prison camp)|Imperial outpost]] that they would be attacking in order to free Republic [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] of war. According to the reports, the POW camp was lightly manned and would not receive reinforcements for another [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="Bad Intel" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|Intel was wrong. The Imperials sent their reinforcements a day early. When my squad broke into the outpost, we were outnumbered ten-to-one.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="Bad Intel" />}}
However, when the squad launched their attack on the outpost, they discovered that their intelligence was wrong&mdash;the reinforcements were a day early, and the unit was outnumbered by the Imperials at a ratio of ten-to-one. Despite the numerical disadvantage, Sergeant Rusk led his squad in fighting through over<ref name="Bad Intel" /> 130<ref name="Twitter" /> [[Imperial soldier|enemy soldiers]] and rescued the prisoners before escaping the base alive. Rusk's squad suffered a 97.4% casualty rate, though no permanent injuries or fatalities, and all of the prisoners were extracted successfully.<ref name="Bad Intel" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I've been thinking about my original squad. I haven't seen any of them since we liberated that POW camp.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|The Surgeons}}</ref>}}
With the successful completion of the mission, Rusk was reassigned to command another unit,<ref name="Vanished" /> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] recruited the rest of the squad into the [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]. As a black ops unit, the squad was renamed "the Surgeons" and tasked with destabilizing the Empire's command structure by eliminating the enemy's leaders. However, the Surgeons soon began to pursue the families of their assigned targets, and the squad was convicted of war crimes and forced to serve out life sentences in a [[Berrun detention center|detention facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]].<ref name="The Surgeons" /> Reminiscing over the mission later led Rusk to investigate the fates of his former squad,<ref name="Vanished" /> and he was dismayed to learn of their imprisonment.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Imperial outpost was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the conversation "Bad Intel" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class character Sergeant Rusk.<ref name="Bad Intel" /> The conversation leads Rusk to investigate his first squad before the later conversation "Vanished,"<ref name="Vanished" /> and he discovers their imprisonment on Berrun before the conversation "The Surgeons."<ref name="The Surgeons" />
